title: It is coming, you feel it
line: A customer of GoPro skis along two lone tracks, "Never follow random ski tracks...", and off.
proof: Seen 20,200,000 times; the next 15 films drew x5.87

title: The trick, at once
line: A man takes off a mask and snaps it round his wrist inside his first sentence.
proof: Sold: over $100,000 in 48 hours, no paid promotion

title: The hand answers
line: 3Doodler: a pen runs along its own name and leaves the letters standing up in plastic.
proof: Sold: more than $2m pledged, $1m in three days

title: It answers a hand
line: A young inventor brings a paper ball near a cardboard box; the lid opens by itself.
proof: Seen 4,200,000 times; the next 15 films drew x2.88

title: This is that
line: A maker's man at a fair: the bundle on wheels and the tower behind it are the same thing.
